2026-11-09T04:11:55.4172547Z       "body": "This PR contains the following updates:\n\n| Package | Change | [Age](https://docs.renovatebot.com/merge-confidence/) | [Confidence](https://docs.renovatebot.com/merge-confidence/) |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| [github.com/prometheus/client_golang](https://github.com/prometheus/client_golang) | `v1.21.1` → `v1.25.0` | ![age](https://developer.mend.io/api/mc/badges/age/go/github.com%2fprometheus%2fclient_golang/v1.25.0?slim=true) | ![confidence](https://developer.mend.io/api/mc/badges/confidence/go/github.com%2fprometheus%2fclient_golang/v1.21.1/v1.25.0?slim=true) |\n\n---\n\n### Release Notes\n\n\u003cdetails\u003e\n\u003csummary\u003eprometheus/client_golang (github.com/prometheus/client_golang)\u003c/summary\u003e\n\n### [`v1.25.0`](https://github.com/prometheus/client_golang/releases/tag/v1.25.0)\n\n[Compare Source](https://github.com/prometheus/client_golang/compare/v1.24.1...v1.25.0)\n\n:warning: This release raises the minimum required Go version to 1.26 and includes breaking API changes in `api/prometheus/v1` (see the \\[CHANGE] entries below). :warning:\n\n#### 1.25.0 / 2026-10-07\n\n- \\[CHANGE] Minimum required Go version is now 1.26, only the two latest Go versions (1.26 and 1.27) are supported from now on. [#\u0026#8203;2138](https://github.com/prometheus/client_golang/issues/2138)\n- \\[CHANGE] api/prometheus/v1: `Query`, `QueryRange`, `Series`, `LabelNames`, and `LabelValues` now return `Infos` annotations in addition to `Warnings`, matching the Prometheus server's info annotations. This changes the signatures of these methods and of `api.Client`'s `Do`/`DoGetFallback`; custom API client implementations must be updated. [#\u0026#8203;1963](https://github.com/prometheus/client_golang/issues/1963)\n- \\[CHANGE] api/prometheus/v1: Rework `TSDBBlocks` result types to align with the Prometheus server's `tsdb.BlockMeta`: `TSDBBlocksResult` now contains `Blocks []TSDBBlockMeta` directly instead of mirroring the full API envelope, nested types are renamed (`TSDBBlockMeta`, `TSDBBlockStats`, `TSDBBlockMetaCompaction`), stat fields are `uint64` with `omitempty` tags, and the optional compaction `parents` field is included. [#\u0026#8203;1928](https://github.com/prometheus/client_golang/issues/1928)\n- \\[FEATURE] testutil: Add `GatherAndFormat` to encode a subset of metrics from a Gatherer. [#\u0026#8203;2091](https://github.com/prometheus/client_golang/issues/2091)\n- \\[FEATURE] promhttp: Add `HandlerOpts.AcceptedFormats` to customize the formats negotiated from the incoming `Accept` header, enabling opt-in to experimental formats such as OpenMetrics 2.0 without changing default negotiation. [#\u0026#8203;2146](https://github.com/prometheus/client_golang/issues/2146)\n- \\[ENHANCEMENT] promhttp: Negotiated metrics responses now include a `Vary` header. [#\u0026#8203;2142](https://github.com/prometheus/client_golang/issues/2142)\n- \\[ENHANCEMENT] prometheus: Regenerate the default runtime collector metrics for Go 1.25 and Go 1.26. [#\u0026#8203;2090](https://github.com/prometheus/client_golang/issues/2090), [#\u0026#8203;2095](https://github.com/prometheus/client_golang/issues/2095)\n- \\[ENHANCEMENT] testutil: Finalize OpenMetrics output in `GatherAndFormat` and `CollectAndFormat` (terminating `# EOF`). [#\u0026#8203;2125](https://github.com/prometheus/client_golang/issues/2125)\n- \\[BUGFIX] api: Match complete URL path placeholders only; a `:foo` argument no longer substitutes inside `:foobar`. [#\u0026#8203;2136](https://github.com/prometheus/client_golang/issues/2136)\n- \\[BUGFIX] exp/api/remote: Reset the pooled buffer before generic proto marshaling, preventing corrupted remote-write payloads. [#\u0026#8203;2139](https://github.com/prometheus/client_golang/issues/2139)\n- \\[BUGFIX] testutil/promlint: Fix \"mibi\" unit prefix to \"mebi\". [#\u0026#8203;2135](https://github.com/prometheus/client_golang/issues/2135)\n\n\u003cdetails\u003e\n\u003csummary\u003e What's changed \u003c/summary\u003e\n\n#### What's Changed\n* fix: Remove
